core_obligations: Use that the comparison map is globally defined and that both sides commute with localization, so that the statement may be checked locally on X (proof lines 12890-12894).
Hence assume K is represented by a strictly perfect complex E^bullet (proof lines 12893-12894).

Show compatibility with distinguished triangles in the first variable, so that the claim reduces to the case of a single finite free module; then verify that case, completing the proof up to line 12930 (proof lines 12896-12930).
proof_roadmap: Localize to make K strictly perfect.
Reduce along distinguished triangles to a single free module.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for perfect K the evaluation comparison map R-Hom(L, M) tensor K -> R-Hom(R-Hom(K, L), M) is an isomorphism. The proof first reduces locally on X, because both sides commute with localization, so that K may be assumed strictly perfect; it then checks compatibility with distinguished triangles in K, which reduces the statement to the case of a single finite free module (proof lines 12889-12930). H2: the reduction through localization and the triangle argument to the free case is the substance, and it is a complete derivation rather than a citation.
